sections.body:
**What this code covers**

- Calculate all distance/similarity metrics between two vectors.
- METRIC CHEAT SHEET USE COSINE when: Comparing text/document similarity Text length varies (long vs short docs) OpenAI/most NLP embeddings USE DOT…
- Quick reference for all key parameters and patterns
- Top_k is NOT supported by OpenAI (use Groq/Anthropic for top_k)
- QUICK REFERENCE: GROQ PARAMETERS (includes top_k!)
- Top_k=40, # Groq supports top_k! (OpenAI doesn't)
- ALL DISTANCE FORMULAS — QUICK REFERENCE

```python
# file: 10_master_reference.py
# Quick reference for all key parameters and patterns

from openai import OpenAI
from groq import Groq
import numpy as np
from dotenv import load_dotenv
import os

load_dotenv()
openai_client = OpenAI(api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
groq_client   = Groq(api_key=os.getenv("GROQ_API_KEY"))

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# QUICK REFERENCE: ALL OPENAI PARAMETERS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

response = openai_client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o",              # Model to use
    messages=[                   # Conversation messages
        {
            "role": "system",    # System prompt (LLM's personality/instructions)
            "content": "You are a helpful assistant."
        },
        {
            "role": "user",      # Human's message
            "content": "Hello!"
        },
        {
            "role": "assistant", # Previous AI response (for multi-turn)
            "content": "Hi there! How can I help you today?"
        },
        {
            "role": "user",
            "content": "What is 2 + 2?"
        }
    ],
    
    # ── GENERATION CONTROL ──────────────────────────
    max_tokens=500,              # Max tokens to generate (response length limit)
    temperature=0.7,             # 0.0=deterministic, 2.0=very creative
    top_p=0.9,                   # Nucleus sampling (use 1.0 if using temperature)
    # top_k is NOT supported by OpenAI (use Groq/Anthropic for top_k)
    
    # ── REPETITION CONTROL ──────────────────────────
    frequency_penalty=0.0,       # -2.0 to 2.0. +ve = reduce repeated words
    presence_penalty=0.0,        # -2.0 to 2.0. +ve = encourage new topics
    
    # ── OUTPUT CONTROL ──────────────────────────────
    n=1,                         # How many completions to generate
    stream=False,                # True = token-by-token streaming
    stop=None,                   # Stop sequence e.g., ["\n\n", "END"]
    
    # ── SPECIAL OUTPUT ──────────────────────────────
    response_format={"type": "text"},  # or {"type": "json_object"}
    seed=42,                     # For reproducibility (makes output deterministic)
    
    # ── IDENTIFICATION ──────────────────────────────
    user="user-123",             # Track which user made the request (optional)
)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# QUICK REFERENCE: GROQ PARAMETERS (includes top_k!)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

groq_response = groq_client.chat.completions.create(
    model="llama-3.3-70b-versatile",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}],
    
    max_tokens=500,
    temperature=0.7,
    top_p=0.9,
    # top_k=40,               # Groq supports top_k! (OpenAI doesn't)
    stream=False,
    stop=None,
)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ALL DISTANCE FORMULAS — QUICK REFERENCE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def all_distances(a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray) -> dict:
    """
    Calculate all distance/similarity metrics between two vectors.
    
    FORMULAS:
    ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    Cosine Similarity = (A·B) / (‖A‖ × ‖B‖)
    Dot Product       = Σ(Aᵢ × Bᵢ)
    Euclidean (L2)    = √[Σ(Aᵢ - Bᵢ)²]
    Manhattan (L1)    = Σ|Aᵢ - Bᵢ|
    ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    """
    dot_product       = np.dot(a, b)
    magnitude_a       = np.linalg.norm(a)
    magnitude_b       = np.linalg.norm(b)
    cosine_sim        = dot_product / (magnitude_a * magnitude_b)
    euclidean_dist    = np.linalg.norm(a - b)
    manhattan_dist    = np.sum(np.abs(a - b))
    
    return {
        "cosine_similarity":  cosine_sim,      # Higher = more similar
        "dot_product":        dot_product,     # Higher = more similar
        "euclidean_distance": euclidean_dist,  # Lower  = more similar
        "manhattan_distance": manhattan_dist,  # Lower  = more similar
    }

# Test
v1 = np.array([1.0, 0.5, 0.8, 0.3])
v2 = np.array([0.9, 0.6, 0.7, 0.4])

metrics = all_distances(v1, v2)
print("\n📐 ALL DISTANCE METRICS:")
for name, value in metrics.items():
    print(f"   {name:<25}: {value:.6f}")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CHEAT SHEET: WHEN TO USE WHICH METRIC
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("""
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    METRIC CHEAT SHEET                           │
├─────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ USE COSINE when:    │ Comparing text/document similarity        │
│                     │ Text length varies (long vs short docs)   │
│                     │ OpenAI/most NLP embeddings                │
├─────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ USE DOT PRODUCT     │ Vectors are already normalized            │
│ when:               │ In neural network attention layers        │
│                     │ Recommendation systems                    │
├─────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ USE EUCLIDEAN when: │ Clustering algorithms (K-means)           │
│                     │ Image embeddings                          │
│                     │ When magnitude/scale matters              │
├─────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ USE MANHATTAN when: │ Sparse high-dimensional vectors           │
│                     │ When you want outlier robustness          │
│                     │ Geographic distance (city grid)           │
└─────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                 TEMPERATURE CHEAT SHEET                         │
├──────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┤
│ CODE/SQL GENERATION          │ temperature=0.0                  │
│ FACTUAL Q&A                  │ temperature=0.0-0.3              │
│ SUMMARIZATION                │ temperature=0.3-0.5              │
│ CHATBOTS / EMAILS            │ temperature=0.7-0.9              │
│ CREATIVE WRITING             │ temperature=1.0-1.5              │
│ BRAINSTORMING                │ temperature=1.5-2.0              │
└──────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────┘
""")
```

# 📊 Formula Quick-Reference Card

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║              ALL FORMULAS AT A GLANCE                          ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                                                  ║
║  COSINE SIMILARITY:                                              ║
║                    A · B          Σ(Aᵢ × Bᵢ)                   ║
║     cos_sim(A,B) = ─────── = ───────────────────                ║
║                   ‖A‖ × ‖B‖   √(ΣAᵢ²) × √(ΣBᵢ²)              ║
║     Range: [-1, +1]  Higher = More Similar                       ║
║                                                                  ║
║  DOT PRODUCT:                                                    ║
║     A · B = Σ(Aᵢ × Bᵢ) = A₁B₁ + A₂B₂ + ... + AₙBₙ            ║
║     Range: (-∞, +∞)  Higher = More Similar                      ║
║                                                                  ║
║  EUCLIDEAN DISTANCE (L2):                                        ║
║     d(A,B) = √[Σ(Aᵢ - Bᵢ)²]                                   ║
║            = √[(A₁-B₁)² + (A₂-B₂)² + ... + (Aₙ-Bₙ)²]         ║
║     Range: [0, +∞)  Lower = More Similar                        ║
║                                                                  ║
║  MANHATTAN DISTANCE (L1):                                        ║
║     d(A,B) = Σ|Aᵢ - Bᵢ| = |A₁-B₁| + |A₂-B₂| + ... + |Aₙ-Bₙ| ║
║     Range: [0, +∞)  Lower = More Similar                        ║
║                                                                  ║
║  MAGNITUDE (Vector Length):                                      ║
║     ‖A‖ = √(A₁² + A₂² + ... + Aₙ²) = √(ΣAᵢ²)                 ║
║                                                                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
```
